@@ -0,0 +1,317 @@
+# Proving Ground runs
+
+English | [中文](README.zh.md)
+
+Records of real Proving Ground runs: the district's certified measurements of one implementer on registered environments, kept exactly as the harness folded and exported them. A run directory is the output of one fleet plan: the cell session logs, the exported session facts, the curator-gated trajectory export, the observatory snapshot and page, the driver's report, and a manifest with every file's digest. Nothing in a run directory is edited after the run; the table below is read from those files.
+
+## Layout
+
+```
+data/proving-ground/
+  <date>-<implementer>-run-<n>/
+    manifest.json        repository head, composition, implementer, session ids, per-file bytes and SHA-256
+    result.json          the driver's report: fleet report, delegation records, export reports, observatory document
+    facts.jsonl          scorekeeper facts, one per cell session
+    trajectories.jsonl   curator-gated trajectory export, one per exported session
+    observatory.json     the observatory snapshot the page was rendered from
+    observatory.html     the rendered observatory page
+    sessions/            the cell session logs, one JSONL file per cell, named by session id
+  folds/<date>-<candidate>-against-<baseline>-<tier>.json   an offline paired fold of two recorded fleets that differ by a composition overlay, or a counterfactual of one recorded fleet re-read under a cap
+  folds/<date>-<reading>-<tier>-seed<seed>.json             an offline reading over recorded arms that share a tier and seed: the routing reading (oracle and cascades over single-model arms) or the repeatability of one arm across its runs
+  dashboard.html                                            the Proving Ground dashboard, one self-contained page folded from every record and fold above by tools/build-dashboard.mjs
+```
+
+## Running one
+
+A run is a Loader-booted composition under `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/` driven from an empty directory outside the repository; the driver creates the session store there and writes the exports next to it. The first run used the composition below, with the host's own Claude Code installation and account as the implementer of every cell:
+
+```sh
+mkdir -p /tmp/proving-ground-run && cd /tmp/proving-ground-run
+REPO=/path/to/deepseek-harness
+TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$REPO/tsconfig.json node --import $REPO/node_modules/tsx/dist/esm/index.mjs $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/driver.ts $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/cordis.yml > stdout.jsonl
+```
+
+Then record it, which copies the exports, every session log, and the driver's result into a new run directory, writes its `manifest.json` with the repository head, the composition, the implementers read from the run stamps, and every file's digest, and refuses to overwrite a recorded run; add a row below afterwards:
+
+```sh
+node data/proving-ground/tools/record-run.mjs /tmp/proving-ground-run 2026-09-06-claude-code-run-2 --composition examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/cordis.yml
+```
+
+A live district (`examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/`) is recorded the same way from the directory its driver runs in, one slot per run directory: the shift ledger session lands beside the cell sessions and `result.json` holds the driver's status.
+
+## What a row proves
+
+A delegated cell's certificate proves that the runner authored the standard before any work started, restored the immutable paths from the fixture over the tree the external agent left, found the check-owned set unchanged, and ran the checks itself. It proves nothing about how the work was done: the external agent's prompts, tool calls, and reasoning stay in its own product, so the cell session holds the stamp, the standard, the delegation records, the runs, and the certificate, and no assistant turn. The exported trajectory therefore carries no step. It is a measurement, not training data, and the `implementer` field on the stamp is what a curated export filters on. The [external implementer note](../../.agents/notes/proposed/architecture/2026-09-06-external-implementer.md) owns these rules.
+
+## What a cell reached outside its workspace
+
+Every record here ran its cells in a sibling layout — each cell workspace directly under the run directory, beside `plan.json`, the run log, and every other cell of the same fleet — and the records dated 2026-09-08 and earlier ran them unconfined, so nothing stopped a cell from reading any of it. [`tools/census-escapes.mjs`](tools/census-escapes.mjs) reads one record and reports, per cell, the tool calls whose path arguments name the run directory or another cell and the reads the barrier refused; [`tools/record-run.mjs`](tools/record-run.mjs) prints that census, and the per-arm totals below, with every record it writes. [`tools/summarize-run.mjs`](tools/summarize-run.mjs) reads one record the same way, or a run directory a driver is still writing, and prints, per cell, the arm, the implementer and route, the certificate, the attempts, the wall seconds, the steps, and the usage (a delegated cell's from its delegation records, as the runner reports it), then one line of totals per arm; the certificate counts, attempts, and usage the paragraphs below state are read from it. Over this corpus it finds cells that left their own workspace in ten records: 4 of 12 in `2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t2`, 11 of 18 in `2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t4`, 3 of 36 in `2026-09-07-bench-e2-harness-vs-product-t3`, 8 of 36 in `2026-09-08-bench-e1-haiku-vs-sonnet-t3`, 7 of 36 in `2026-09-08-bench-e1-sonnet-vs-opus-t3`, 6 of 32 in `2026-09-08-bench-e2-harness-vs-product-t5`, 7 of 18 in `2026-09-08-bench-e3-attempts1-t3`, 3 of 18 in `2026-09-08-bench-e3-baseline-t3`, 15 of 18 in `2026-09-08-bench-e4-knowledge-pack-t3`, and 9 of 16 in `2026-09-08-bench-h1-harness-loop-t5`; the other eight records count none, seven of them because every cell was delegated to the product, where the harness session holds no tool call of its own and the census can see nothing the delegate did, and the eighth because it is a one-cell smoke. Two escapes changed what a row measures: in `2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t2` the `code:csv-codec` cell `cell-cUuWY2` ran `cp cell-cUuWY2/src/csv.js cell-R8QtdK/src/csv.js`, putting its own solution into the other repetition of its task, and in `2026-09-08-bench-e2-harness-vs-product-t5` the first `code:sheet-eval` cell `cell-Cr3CtN` wrote its whole solution into the second cell's workspace, `cell-XNKQXT`. A record made under a composition that confines its cells — where the runner denies each cell everything above its own workspace for the length of its run — carries the refusals as `escapesDenied` on every scoreboard and observatory row, so the count is read from the row rather than reconstructed from the log.

+The thirtieth record is the drop arm run as a fleet under the fixed overlay, launched at 17:43 UTC, eighty minutes after its baseline: the same 16 cells, seed 2, the same ladder, every rung a fresh in-process child of the runner's process on the rung's model with the task restated and the directive carried, the same caps, 5,816 s of wall time at two cells at a time. It certified 14 of 16: 2 at the first rung by the smallest model (ranked-choice, both repetitions), 11 at the second rung by the largest, and 1 at the third (diff3-merge); its two misses (conf-canon and sheet-eval, one repetition each) never reached the strong rung, because the smallest model's single attempt had spent 1,493,040 and 1,472,984 of the cell's 1,500,000 billed tokens rereading its own transcript, and the runner refused the second rung on the breached cap. Folded offline against the twenty-ninth's baseline arm ([folds/2026-09-08-e5-drop-against-kept-transcript-t5.json](folds/2026-09-08-e5-drop-against-kept-transcript-t5.json)), the reading is 0.1875, [0.0625, 0.3125], `promote` by the fold's thresholds: three cells flipped, all toward the fresh child and all on the three tasks the kept transcript failed (build-schedule, conf-canon, sheet-eval), none the other way, with both arms' first rungs at 2 of 16. The fresh child is not cheaper: 575,350 output tokens against 471,583, 16,648,949 billed against 14,911,342, 11,377 s of cell time (median 678 s) against 6,964 (median 441), because every rung reads the task and the workspace from nothing; what it buys is a strong rung that starts from the workspace and the directive instead of from the cheap model's transcript. The fold is offline: its arms ran an hour apart on the shared subscription and were not frozen together, so it is evidence for the slate's prediction that dropping the cheap transcript beats keeping it, not a promotion; the frozen pair on the fixed overlay and a per-rung share of the token cap are queued. The usage of a delegated cell is summed over its `environment/delegation` events, which carry each child's reported model and usage; the census finds no cell leaving its workspace and no read denied.
+
+The twenty-ninth record is the drop arm of the routing hypothesis as it first ran, a frozen paired experiment whose candidate arm never started: the baseline arm, the smallest model on the first rung and the largest on the second and third with the transcript kept (the twenty-seventh's ladder again, on the route), ran its 16 sealed tier-5 cells at seed 2 in 3,760 s of wall time at two cells at a time and certified 11 of 16, 2 at the first rung and 9 at the second, its five misses each stopped by the 1,500,000 billed-token cap (1,471,243 to 1,515,456 billed tokens); the candidate arm, the same ladder with every rung a fresh in-process child through the spawn provider, was refused at every cell before a session existed, because [overlays/with-spawn.cordis.yml](../../examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/overlays/with-spawn.cordis.yml) patched an entry the base composition never names and the include plugin skips such a patch with a warning nothing printed, so no provider was registered under `spawn`. The experiment folded to `inconclusive` with no seed paired ([result.json](2026-09-08-bench-e5-handoff-drop-t5/result.json)), an hour of the largest model spent before a misconfiguration the composition could have refused at load: the overlay now inserts the provider (`5e06f652d`), the fleet and the experiments service refuse an unavailable implementer before any cell runs, and `verify-cordis-config` fails on an include patch that reaches nothing (`f0a684ef0`), which found two more compositions with the same defect. The census finds four cells leaving their workspace in eight tool calls, two of them naming the run directory, and no read denied.
+
+The twenty-eighth record is the held-out reliability estimate the program was to end on: one fleet of the middle model on the harness loop over the eight held-out environments (three at tier 2, three at tier 3, two at tier 5), which no audit, prompt fix, overlay, or fold of this program had touched, seed 3, two repetitions, 16 cells, 2,299 s of wall time at two cells at a time, on the sealed composition ([cordis.yml](../../examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/cordis.yml)) under its three-attempt bound. It certified 15 of 16, every one at the first attempt; the one miss is glob-brace at repetition 0, which ran all three attempts out in 1,270 s while its sibling passed at the first attempt in 473 s, so the four tier-5 cells read 3 of 4 and the twelve cells of tiers 2 and 3 read 12 of 12. The cells took 4,543 s in all (median 210 s), 195 steps, 363,264 output tokens, and 586,558 cache-write tokens. The observatory withholds all eight rows, as it withholds held-out rows from every page ([observatory.json](2026-09-08-bench-held-out-sonnet-all/observatory.json): eight held-out rows over sixteen sessions), so the number is read from the fleet report and the session logs, and it stands as the untuned estimate of the harness loop on this model: 15 of 16 on tasks nothing in the program had seen, beside 13 to 15 of 16 on the audited tier-5 eight; the two sets differ in tier, so only the tier-5 cells' 3 of 4 speaks to the audited difficulty. The census finds one cell leaving its workspace in one tool call, reaching only the parent directory and naming neither the run directory nor a sibling, and no read denied.
+
+The twenty-seventh record is the handoff tax as a frozen paired experiment on the attempt ladder: the largest product model on three rungs as the baseline against the smallest model on the first rung and the largest on the second and third with the transcript kept, over the eight audited tier-5 environments, seed 2, two repetitions, 32 cells, 5,862 s of wall time at two cells at a time, sealed. The baseline certified 16 of 16 at the first attempt, the fourth such sweep of the largest model on these cells. The ladder certified 14 of 16: the smallest model's first attempt made 2 (lex-states and ranked-choice, one repetition each), the largest model on the second rung recovered 11, the third rung 1 more (diff3-merge), and two cells ran all three attempts out (conf-canon and rate-limit-sim, one repetition each), where the largest model, holding a failed first attempt it did not write, missed twice on tasks it has never missed from a clean start in 64 cells. Delta −0.125, interval [−0.25, 0], inconclusive: two cells in sixteen, at the noise floor, and never above zero. The tax is in the cost, not the verdict. The ladder spent 8,122 s of cell time against 3,251 (medians 531 s against 175), 535 model steps against 181, 500,664 output tokens against 198,637, 1,150,560 cache-write against 328,456, and 14,245,694 cache-read against 2,651,444; the smallest model's rung alone cost 406 steps, 312,430 output tokens, and 9,401,938 cache-read before the largest model ran at all, and the largest model's own share after the handoff (129 steps, 188,234 output tokens) is within a step or a token of what it spends from a clean start (181 and 198,637 here, 164 and 189,169 in the twentieth record), so the inherited transcript saved it nothing. +
+The seventh record is the first cell the harness's own loop certified on the Claude Code route, immediately after the route began offering the harness tools natively: five model queries, five tool calls (explore, read the tests, read the stub, write the module, run the suite), no retry, one validation, 41 s from stamp to certificate, 2580 output tokens. The same environment took the product loop 59 and 63 s in the fourth record. Before that route change the same cell failed every query at the product's turn bound, which the route's note records.
+
+The sixth record completes the product loop's pass over the bench: the nine tier-4 environments that are not held out, eighteen cells, every one certified in one attempt, 58 to 235 s per cell, 1151 s of wall time at two cells at a time. Tier 4 hands the implementer an existing module with planted defects and an immutable suite, which is why its cells are faster than tier 3's. Across the three fleets the product loop certified 48 of 48 cells at one attempt each, so on certificates this bench does not separate implementers at any tier for this product model; the bench's next slice is a harder tier and the six held-out environments, and every comparison below that reads attempts, wall time, and spend.
+
+The fifth record is the same fleet plan on the nine tier-3 environments that are not held out: eighteen cells, every one certified in one attempt, 71 to 389 s per cell, 1844 s of wall time at two cells at a time. Tier 3 is therefore also a ceiling for the product loop on this bench, and a comparison that only counts certificates cannot separate implementers below tier 4; the separating measures at these tiers are attempts, wall time, and spend, of which the delegation record holds the first two and will hold the child's reported spend once the queued slice lands.
+
+The fourth record is the Proving Ground bench's first fleet (`examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/`, thirty admitted program tasks): the product's own loop as the implementer of every cell, over the six tier-2 environments that are not held out, two repetitions each, seed 1, policy `bench-2026-09-07`, district `bench-h1`, two cells at a time, 984 s of wall time for the twelve cells. Every cell was certified in one attempt, so tier 2 is a ceiling for this implementer and the paired comparisons between the harness loop and the product loop run on tiers 3 and 4. The cells name the model `sonnet`; the product ran the installation's default model, which was measured as sonnet immediately before the run, because the delegation did not yet forward the cell's model to the child (the slice that forwards it and records the child's reported model is queued). The bench composition and tasks are those of commit `128e037bb`; the manifest records the head of the working tree at recording time.
+
+The third record is the same district left running overnight: 22 slots on its thirty-minute cadence from 22:16 to 09:16 UTC, including the first slot the second record holds. The host restarted once; the slot due at 00:16 was not caught up, exactly as the shift driver's cadence rule states, and the relaunched process resumed the same ledger and cadence from 00:46 on the working tree of that moment, so the slots before the restart ran the tree at `88f6a1f2e` and the slots after it the tree at `38dd04165`, which the manifest records as the head. Every one of the 66 cells was certified in one attempt; the record holds all 22 shift ledgers, the 66 cell sessions, and the exports folded over them.
+
+The second run is the live district's first slot after two defects the district itself exposed were fixed: a test check this Node rejected, and a runner that overlaid the whole fixture before validation and so discarded every edit to a fixture-supplied source file. Three program tasks, each with an immutable test suite, were implemented by the product in one attempt each and certified by the runner on the trees it left; the held-out task never entered the plan.
+
+The first run is the first time an agent other than the harness itself was measured by the Proving Ground: two smoke environments at `isolation: none`, one child run per attempt recorded as `environment/delegation`, every delegation ending `completed`, facts exported for both sessions, both trajectories exported through the curator with one rewarded, and the observatory publishing both rows under the `claude-code` implementer with `runner` as the certificate executor of the certified one.

+# Proving Ground 运行记录
+
+[English](README.md) | 中文
+
+真实 Proving Ground 运行的记录：该区对一个实现者（implementer）在已注册环境上的经认证测量，完全按 harness 折叠和导出的原样保存。一个运行目录就是一次 fleet 计划的输出：cell 会话日志、导出的会话事实、经 curator 把关的 trajectory 导出、observatory 快照与页面、驱动器的报告，以及带有每个文件摘要的 manifest。运行目录中的任何内容在运行之后都不再编辑；下表由这些文件读出。
+
+## Layout
+
+```
+data/proving-ground/
+  <date>-<implementer>-run-<n>/
+    manifest.json        repository head, composition, implementer, session ids, per-file bytes and SHA-256
+    result.json          the driver's report: fleet report, delegation records, export reports, observatory document
+    facts.jsonl          scorekeeper facts, one per cell session
+    trajectories.jsonl   curator-gated trajectory export, one per exported session
+    observatory.json     the observatory snapshot the page was rendered from
+    observatory.html     the rendered observatory page
+    sessions/            the cell session logs, one JSONL file per cell, named by session id
+  folds/<date>-<candidate>-against-<baseline>-<tier>.json   an offline paired fold of two recorded fleets that differ by a composition overlay, or a counterfactual of one recorded fleet re-read under a cap
+  folds/<date>-<reading>-<tier>-seed<seed>.json             an offline reading over recorded arms that share a tier and seed: the routing reading (oracle and cascades over single-model arms) or the repeatability of one arm across its runs
+  dashboard.html                                            the Proving Ground dashboard, one self-contained page folded from every record and fold above by tools/build-dashboard.mjs
+```
+
+## 运行一次
+
+一次运行是 `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/` 下的一个由 Loader 启动的组合，从仓库之外的一个空目录驱动；驱动器在那里创建会话存储，并把导出写在它旁边。第一次运行使用了下面的组合，以宿主机自己的 Claude Code 安装和账户作为每个 cell 的实现者：
+
+```sh
+mkdir -p /tmp/proving-ground-run && cd /tmp/proving-ground-run
+REPO=/path/to/deepseek-harness
+TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$REPO/tsconfig.json node --import $REPO/node_modules/tsx/dist/esm/index.mjs $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/driver.ts $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/cordis.yml > stdout.jsonl
+```
+
+然后记录它：该工具把导出、每份会话日志和驱动器的结果复制到一个新的运行目录，写出带有仓库 head、组合、从运行 stamp 读出的实现者以及每个文件摘要的 `manifest.json`，并拒绝覆盖已记录的运行；之后再在下表中加一行：
+
+```sh
+node data/proving-ground/tools/record-run.mjs /tmp/proving-ground-run 2026-09-06-claude-code-run-2 --composition examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/cordis.yml
+```
+
+实时区（`examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/`）以同样方式从其驱动器运行所在的目录记录，每个时槽一个运行目录：班次账本会话与 cell 会话并排落地，`result.json` 保存驱动器的状态。
+
+## 一行证明了什么
+
+一个被委托的 cell 的证书证明：runner 在任何工作开始之前就编写了标准，在外部 agent 留下的目录树上从 fixture 恢复了不可变路径，确认由检查拥有的文件集未被改动，并亲自运行了检查。它不证明工作是如何完成的：外部 agent 的提示、工具调用和推理都留在它自己的产品里，因此 cell 会话只保存 stamp、标准、委托记录、运行和证书，而没有任何助手轮次。导出的 trajectory 因此不含任何步骤。它是一次测量，而不是训练数据，stamp 上的 `implementer` 字段就是经策展的导出所要过滤的依据。[外部实现者说明](../../.agents/notes/proposed/architecture/2026-09-06-external-implementer.md)拥有这些规则。
+
+## 一个 cell 在自己工作区之外触及了什么
+
+这里的每份记录都以并列布局运行其 cell——每个 cell 工作区都直接位于运行目录之下，与 `plan.json`、运行日志以及同一 fleet 的其他所有 cell 并排——而日期在 2026-09-08 及更早的记录都是无约束运行的，因此没有任何东西阻止一个 cell 读取其中任何内容。[`tools/census-escapes.mjs`](tools/census-escapes.mjs) 读取一份记录，按 cell 报告其路径参数指向运行目录或另一个 cell 的工具调用，以及屏障拒绝的读取；[`tools/record-run.mjs`](tools/record-run.mjs) 在写出每份记录时打印该普查以及下述按 arm 的合计。[`tools/summarize-run.mjs`](tools/summarize-run.mjs) 以同样的方式读取一份记录，或一个驱动器仍在写入的运行目录，按 cell 打印 arm、implementer 与路由、证书、尝试次数、墙上秒数、步数与用量（被委派的 cell 的用量来自它的委派记录，与运行器所报告的一致），然后按 arm 各打印一行合计；下文各段所陈述的证书计数、尝试次数与用量即读自它。在这份语料上，它在十份记录中发现了离开自己工作区的 cell：`2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t2` 中 12 之 4，`2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t4` 中 18 之 11，`2026-09-07-bench-e2-harness-vs-product-t3` 中 36 之 3，`2026-09-08-bench-e1-haiku-vs-sonnet-t3` 中 36 之 8，`2026-09-08-bench-e1-sonnet-vs-opus-t3` 中 36 之 7，`2026-09-08-bench-e2-harness-vs-product-t5` 中 32 之 6，`2026-09-08-bench-e3-attempts1-t3` 中 18 之 7，`2026-09-08-bench-e3-baseline-t3` 中 18 之 3，`2026-09-08-bench-e4-knowledge-pack-t3` 中 18 之 15，以及 `2026-09-08-bench-h1-harness-loop-t5` 中 16 之 9；其余八份记录计数为零，其中七份是因为每个 cell 都被委托给了产品，harness 会话本身不保存任何工具调用，普查看不到受托方做过什么，第八份则是一份单 cell 的冒烟记录。有两次外出改变了一行所测量的东西：在 `2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t2` 中，`code:csv-codec` 的 cell `cell-cUuWY2` 运行了 `cp cell-cUuWY2/src/csv.js cell-R8QtdK/src/csv.js`，把自己的解答放进了同一任务另一次重复的工作区；在 `2026-09-08-bench-e2-harness-vs-product-t5` 中，第一个 `code:sheet-eval` 的 cell `cell-Cr3CtN` 把自己的整份解答写进了第二个 cell 的工作区 `cell-XNKQXT`。在一个约束其 cell 的组合下产生的记录——runner 在一次运行期间拒绝每个 cell 访问自己工作区之上的一切——会把这些拒绝作为 `escapesDenied` 带在每一行 scoreboard 与 observatory 行上，因此这个计数从行中读出，而不必从日志重建。

+第三十份记录是在修复后的叠加层下作为一次 fleet 运行的丢弃臂，于 17:43 UTC 启动，比它的基线晚八十分钟：同样的 16 个单元，种子 2，同一阶梯，每一级都是运行器进程内的一个新子代理，在该级的模型上运行，任务被重述、指令被带上，同样的上限，两个单元并行共 5,816 s 墙上时间。它认证了 16 之 14：2 个在第一级由最小模型取得（ranked-choice，两次重复），11 个在第二级由最大模型取得，1 个在第三级（diff3-merge）；它的两次错过（conf-canon 与 sheet-eval，各一次重复）从未到达强模型那一级，因为最小模型的单次尝试在重读自己的对话记录上已花掉单元 1,500,000 计费 token 中的 1,493,040 与 1,472,984，运行器在突破的上限上拒绝了第二级。对第二十九份的基线臂离线折叠（[folds/2026-09-08-e5-drop-against-kept-transcript-t5.json](folds/2026-09-08-e5-drop-against-kept-transcript-t5.json)），读数为 0.1875，[0.0625, 0.3125]，按折叠的阈值为 `promote`：三个单元翻转，全部朝向新子代理，全部在保留对话记录所失败的三个任务上（build-schedule、conf-canon、sheet-eval），没有反向的，两臂的第一级都是 16 之 2。新子代理并不更便宜：输出 token 575,350 对 471,583，计费 16,648,949 对 14,911,342，单元时间 11,377 s（中位数 678 s）对 6,964（中位数 441），因为每一级都从零读取任务与工作区；它买到的是一个从工作区与指令、而不是从廉价模型的对话记录起步的强模型级。这个折叠是离线的：两臂在共享订阅上相隔一小时运行，未曾一起冻结，所以它是对清单预测"丢弃廉价模型的对话记录优于保留它"的证据，而不是晋升；修复后叠加层上的冻结配对与 token 上限的按级份额已排入队列。被委托单元的用量按其 `environment/delegation` 事件求和，这些事件带有每个子代理报告的模型与用量；普查发现没有单元离开工作区，也没有任何读取被拒绝。

+第二十九份记录是路由假设的丢弃臂第一次运行时的样子，一个候选臂从未启动的冻结配对实验：基线臂——第一级最小模型、第二与第三级最大模型并保留对话记录（第二十七份的阶梯，再次走 route）——在种子 2 下以两个单元并行共 3,760 s 墙上时间跑完 16 个密封的第 5 层单元，认证了 16 之 11，2 个在第一级、9 个在第二级，五次错过各自被 1,500,000 计费 token 的上限截停（计费 1,471,243 到 1,515,456 个 token）；候选臂——同一阶梯，但每一级都是经 spawn 提供者的一个新的进程内子代理——在每个单元上都在会话存在之前就被拒绝，因为 [overlays/with-spawn.cordis.yml](../../examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/overlays/with-spawn.cordis.yml) 修补了一个基础组合从未命名的条目，而 include 插件会以一条无人打印的警告跳过这样的补丁，于是 `spawn` 名下没有注册任何提供者。实验折叠为 `inconclusive`，没有任何种子配对（[result.json](2026-09-08-bench-e5-handoff-drop-t5/result.json)），在一个组合本可在加载时拒绝的错误配置之前花掉了最大模型的一小时：叠加层现在插入该提供者（`5e06f652d`），fleet 与实验服务在任何单元运行之前拒绝不可用的实现者，`verify-cordis-config` 对触及不到任何条目的 include 补丁报错（`f0a684ef0`），并由此发现了另外两个带同一缺陷的组合。普查发现四个单元在八次工具调用中离开了工作区，其中两次提到运行目录，没有任何读取被拒绝。

+第二十八份记录是本计划收尾所要的保留集可靠性估计：中等模型在 harness 循环上的一次 fleet，覆盖八个保留环境（第 2 层三个、第 3 层三个、第 5 层两个），本计划中的任何审计、提示修正、叠加层或折叠都未触及它们，种子 3，两次重复，16 个单元，两个单元并行共 2,299 s 墙上时间，在密封组合（[cordis.yml](../../examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/cordis.yml)）上以其三次尝试为上限。它认证了 16 之 15，全部在第一次尝试；唯一的错过是重复 0 的 glob-brace，用尽三次尝试耗时 1,270 s，而它的同胞单元在第一次尝试 473 s 内通过，因此第 5 层的四个单元读作 4 之 3，第 2、3 层的十二个单元读作 12 之 12。各单元合计 4,543 s（中位数 210 s）、195 步、363,264 个输出 token 与 586,558 个缓存写入 token。观测台扣留全部八行，正如它在任何页面上都扣留保留集的行（[observatory.json](2026-09-08-bench-held-out-sonnet-all/observatory.json)：十六个会话的八个保留集行），所以这个数字读自 fleet 报告与会话日志，并作为 harness 循环在该模型上的未调优估计成立：在本计划中没有任何东西见过的任务上 16 之 15，旁边是经审计的第 5 层八个任务上的 16 之 13 到 15；两组的层级不同，所以只有第 5 层单元的 4 之 3 说的是经审计那一层的难度。普查发现一个单元在一次工具调用中离开了工作区，只到达上级目录，没有提到运行目录或同级单元，也没有任何读取被拒绝。
+
+第二十七份记录是作为尝试阶梯上冻结配对实验的交接税：最大产品模型三级作为基线，对最小模型在第一级、最大模型在第二与第三级并保留对话记录，覆盖经审计的八个第 5 层环境，种子 2，两次重复，32 个单元，两个单元并行共 5,862 s 墙上时间，已密封。基线在第一次尝试认证了 16 之 16，是最大模型在这些单元上的第四次这样的全胜。阶梯认证了 16 之 14：最小模型的第一次尝试做到 2 个（lex-states 与 ranked-choice 各一次重复），第二级的最大模型挽回 11 个，第三级再挽回 1 个（diff3-merge），两个单元用尽了三次尝试（conf-canon 与 rate-limit-sim 各一次重复），在那里，拿着一份不是自己写的失败首次尝试的最大模型，在它从干净起点的 64 个单元中从未错过的任务上错过了两次。delta −0.125，区间 [−0.25, 0]，inconclusive：十六个中的两个，在噪声底线上，且从未高于零。税在成本里，不在裁决里。阶梯花费单元合计 8,122 s 对 3,251（中位数 531 s 对 175），535 个模型步骤对 181，输出 token 500,664 对 198,637，缓存写入 1,150,560 对 328,456，缓存读取 14,245,694 对 2,651,444；最小模型那一级在最大模型还没运行之前就单独耗费了 406 步、312,430 个输出 token 与 9,401,938 个缓存读取，而最大模型在交接之后自己的那一份（129 步、188,234 个输出 token）与它从干净起点的花费（这里 181 与 198,637，第二十份记录中 164 与 189,169）只差一步或一个 token，所以继承来的对话记录什么也没有为它省下。在这些任务上从便宜模型升级到强模型能挽回便宜模型错过的大部分证书，14 之 12，代价是在每项指标上都花费一开始就用强模型的两倍半，还要交回两份证书。第二十一份记录的离线级联把这个顺序定价为最大模型输出 token 的 4.9 倍，因为它在升级之前记入了最小模型三次尝试的全部失败；阶梯在一次尝试后就升级，付 2.5 倍，所以实测读数比离线读数便宜，而结论相同，因为强模型在交接之后的工作并不比它自己的第一次尝试便宜。普查发现六个单元在八次工具调用中离开了工作区，两次提到了运行目录或同级单元，每一次得到的都是密封后的空目录，也没有任何读取被拒绝。

+第二十三份记录是作为一个冻结配对实验运行的尝试次数假设，这是尝试阶梯使之成为可能的：运行器把阶梯的长度作为一次运行的尝试上限，因此基线臂给中等模型排三级阶梯，候选臂给同一路由上的同一模型排一级，两臂恰好只在上限上不同，没有叠加层，也没有离线折叠。覆盖经审计的八个第 5 层环境，种子 2，两次重复，32 个单元，两个单元并行共 5,666 s 墙上时间，在带连续性的密封组合上，三次尝试的臂认证了 16 之 15（12 个在第一次尝试，build-schedule、diff3-merge 与 lex-states 各一次在第二次，sheet-eval 一次在三次之后错过），一次尝试的臂认证了 16 之 9，delta −0.375，区间 [−0.5625, −0.1875]，对上限为一裁决为 reject：这个区间六倍地越过了 0.0625 的噪声底线，并且它是记录在案第一个关于 harness 的一种机制而非关于模型的冻结裁决。差异要分两部分读。十六份证书中有三份是在聚类指令之后的第二次尝试取得的，这正是第十一份记录的反事实折叠所预测的 −0.1875，也恰好是上限为一所放弃的东西。另外三份来自第一次尝试本身：一次尝试的臂在第一次尝试认证了 16 之 9，而三次尝试的臂认证了 16 之 12，可第一次尝试在两种阶梯下是同一份交付（只有任务陈述，关于上限的任何东西都不会到达模型），所以这一部分是第一次尝试逐次运行的变动，而不是上限的效应。逐单元看，两臂的第一次尝试在十六个中的九个上不一致（三个是基线错过而候选做到，六个反之），而这个臂的两次三次尝试运行的最终结果只在一到两个上不一致；循环的价值在于它吸收了任务无论在什么上限下都会产生的第一次尝试变动，而在这个基准上对任何模型只读一次尝试，都是比三次尝试嘈杂那么多的一件仪器。上限没有换来速度：单元合计 5,689 s 对 5,400（中位数 295 s 对 300），240 个模型步骤对 219，输出 token 441,504 对 402,346，也就是说后两次尝试在十六个单元上多花 289 s 与 39,158 个输出 token，换来六份证书。普查发现八个单元在十二次工具调用中提到了其父目录或运行目录，每一次得到的都是密封后的空目录，也没有任何读取被拒绝。

+第二十份记录是密封基准上的第一个冻结配对实验，也是第一个区间不含零的实验：中等产品模型作为基线臂，最大模型作为候选臂，在 harness 循环上，覆盖经审计的八个第 5 层环境，种子 2，两次重复，32 个单元，两个单元并行共 5,742 s 墙上时间，所用组合以 bwrap 约束每个单元（单元的父目录是一个只容纳该单元的空 tmpfs），每个 harness 会话复用一个产品会话，并通过保留的检查脚本转发每个隐藏用例的参数。最大模型在第一次尝试认证了 16 之 16；中等模型认证了 16 之 13（11 个在第一次尝试，diff3-merge 与 rate-limit-sim 各一次在第二次，sheet-eval 两次在 1,200,000 ms 墙上上限处错过，lex-states 一次在三次尝试后错过），delta 0.1875，区间 [0.125, 0.25]，在 0.05 最小 delta 下裁决为 promote：在这些任务上最大模型是更好的实现者，差异集中在规范的那些角落，中等模型在三次尝试内没有触及它们。最大模型在每项指标上也都更便宜、更快：164 个模型步骤对 267，单元合计 3,572 s 对 7,451（中位数 204 s 对 387），189,169 个输出 token 对 561,271，而且随着会话连续性上路，花费转为读取主导，候选方 2,185,841 个缓存读取对 317,394 个缓存写入 token，基线方 8,515,603 对 738,281，而第十八份记录的 harness 循环写入 2,927,150、读取 626,621。普查发现七个单元在八次工具调用中提到了运行目录或其父目录；在密封之下，每一次这样的调用看到的都是一个只容纳该单元自己工作区的空目录，记录下来的结果表明了这一点，也没有任何读取被拒绝，因为可以触及的东西没有一样是被拒绝的。这是本项目第一个达到晋升级别的裁决，它晋升的是一个模型而不是 harness 的一项改动；与第十三、十四份记录合读，它说明模型层级在第 3 层饱和之处于第 5 层在证书上分开了，而对 harness 循环对产品循环它尚未说明任何东西，后者的密封重跑随后进行。
+
+第十九份记录是 harness 通过自己的项目工作流评估自身：一个部门在路由上以最大的产品模型，在自己的工作树里阅读十一份文件的证据卷宗（本 README、普查、记录索引、最近三十小时的提交、假设清单、角色矩阵、密封单元说明、ruflo 与基线比较，以及带四个目标的问题）并撰写 `assessment.md`，由一份已提交的验证器认证：要求四个指定章节、两行裁决、至少八条各自引用一份存在的卷宗文件的证据、六份不同文件，以及 600 至 2,500 词；集成在合并后的 head 上重新运行了验证器。部门在第一次验证时、十一步之后获得认证（14 条证据、引用 9 份文件、2,258 词），裁决为 `Viable: undetermined (medium confidence)` 与 `State of the art: in part (medium confidence)`，领先的部分是测量仪器及其强制执行而不是任何实测能力；它还发现本实验室自己的汇总表没有污染列，以及第 2 到 4 层的比较是各自独立舰队的折叠而非冻结实验。这次运行暴露了项目工作流的三个缺陷，全部保存在记录旁的工件目录中（[2026-09-08-self-assessment-program-artefacts/manifest.json](2026-09-08-self-assessment-program-artefacts/manifest.json)）：部门在文件已写出但从未提交的情况下获得认证，于是集成合并了一个空分支并以 `missing assessment.md` 失败；随后无约束的集成代理找到了部门的工作树，用脚本改写了已认证文件中的句子，运营方在 22 步后将其停止；恢复又拒绝重新发布集成会话的身份，于是运营方按当时状态提交了部门的树，把第一个集成会话放到一边并恢复运行，之后集成认证了合并后的 head，项目发布。部门所认证的文本从其自身会话的写入中逐字节重建（`assessment.certified.md`，2,258 词），与合并后的文本相差五行，其中没有一行是裁决。
+
+第十八份记录是第四个冻结的配对实验，也是第八份记录在第 5 层上的形态：harness 循环作为基线臂，产品循环作为候选臂，两侧使用同一个产品模型，在经过审计的八个第 5 层环境上（conf-canon 的参考程序及其六个用例已重新生成，lex-states 与 sheet-eval 的提示已澄清），种子 2，两次重复，32 个单元，两个单元并行共 8,979 s 墙上时间。harness 循环认证了 16 之 12（9 个在第一次尝试，3 个在第二次：diff3-merge、lex-states、rate-limit-sim 各一次），产品循环认证了 16 之 11（10 个在第一次尝试，rate-limit-sim 一次在第二次，这是只收到指令的全新子进程第一次挽回成功），delta −0.0625，区间 [−0.125, 0]，裁决为 inconclusive。有三个单元在两臂之间翻转：产品循环认证了一次 conf-canon 而 harness 循环从未做到；harness 循环两次认证了 uri-resolve，而产品循环的这两个单元各自三次委派都在 125 s 内失败，没有上报的模型与成本，因为它们最后运行，在 04:10 UTC 之后，那时订阅的会话上限已经达到（05:30 重置）；在上限未触及的 14 对中，两臂只差一张证书，产品循环占优。两臂都两次错过 sheet-eval，harness 循环在 1,200,000 ms 墙上上限处被截断，产品循环不受限地在 662 与 714 s 结束，因为这次运行中组合的上限只约束 harness 自身的步骤（预算对等切片在它之后落地）。产品循环是更快的实现者，在 16 对中有 10 对更快，单元合计 7,554 s 对 10,221 s，上报 629,483 个输出 token 与 13.23 USD 的目录价成本；harness 循环的 16 个单元花费 802,872 个输出 token、626,621 个缓存读取与 2,927,150 个缓存写入 token，两个 conf-canon 单元各有一次瞬时的路由重试并恢复。这份记录还带着一次普查在它之后发现的缺陷：harness 循环 16 个单元中有 5 个离开自己的工作区进入运行目录，读取其中的计划与日志以及同一环境的兄弟单元（第二次重复的 lex-states、rate-limit-sim、conf-canon，以及两个 sheet-eval 单元），第一个 sheet-eval 单元更是在第二个的工作区里完成了工作，而没有任何产品循环单元离开过自己的工作区；拒绝单元访问其工作区之上一切内容的密封单元切片已排队，第 5 层比较将在它之下重跑，在此之前这个裁决只能按其本来面目解读。与第十一、十二份记录合读，第 5 层在证书上同样不区分两个循环：两者都落在 16 之 11 或 12，环境相同，错过的也是同样两个任务。
+
+第十一与第十二份记录的一个反事实折叠，写于第 5 层的确认性配对运行之前，把尝试次数上限假设带到真正用到多次尝试的层级（[folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-harness-loop-t5.json](folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-harness-loop-t5.json)、[folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-product-loop-t5.json](folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-product-loop-t5.json)）：每个单元的结果被替换为其第一次尝试单独的结果，这正是同一次运行在上限为一次尝试时会记录下的结果，因为第一次尝试无法观察到其后的尝试。在 harness 循环上，这个上限使 11 张证书损失 3 张（`code:diff3-merge` 两次、`code:lex-states` 一次，均在一条指令之后于第二次尝试中挽回），delta −0.1875，区间 [−0.25, −0.125]，对受限候选方的裁决为 reject；在产品循环上，这个上限没有任何代价，delta 0，区间 [0, 0]，因为它失败的五个单元没有一个在第二或第三次尝试中挽回，而原因在于委派本身：受委派单元的后续尝试会启动一个全新的子进程，它只收到指令，既没有任务提示也没有前一个子进程的记录，而 harness 循环的后续尝试延续同一份记录，任务、自己的工作与指令都在视野之内。因此两个循环的后续尝试并不是同一件仪器，向新子进程重述任务并为每次尝试命名其记录接口的尝试阶梯切片已排在第 5 层重跑之前。两个区间各自只对一次运行的 16 个单元重采样，不包含运行间方差，因此比配对运行得到的区间更窄；在经过审计的第 5 层任务上运行配对的尝试次数上限舰队才是确认步骤，在它落地之前，这个折叠是运行器的指令在 harness 循环上把失败转化为证书、而在今日委派方式下的产品循环上无法做到的证据，不是一次晋升。
+
+第十七份记录是知识包折叠：同样九个第 3 层环境与两次重复，使用把八个主题的 2026-q3 知识包作为会话技能目录提供的组合叠加层运行，并与第十五份记录的基线折叠（[folds/2026-09-08-e4-knowledge-pack-against-baseline-t3.json](folds/2026-09-08-e4-knowledge-pack-against-baseline-t3.json)）：两侧都以第一次尝试认证了 18 之 18 个单元，差值为 0，区间为 [0, 0]。知识包从未被打开：2,778 个字符的目录出现在每个请求中，而没有任何单元发出过技能调用，因此这个折叠度量的是一个模型读到却忽略的目录，而不是被使用的知识。该舰队的单元合计用时 5,433 s，基线为 3,959 s；输出 token 482,920 个，基线为 339,331 个，高于记录在案的其他四支 sonnet 第 3 层舰队（339,331 至 367,172）；单独一支舰队无法说明这是目录造成的还是运行间波动。这个知识包原本要检验的假设，即作为技能提供的与任务相关的知识会改变结果，需要一个其主题为任务所需的知识包；这个包保存的是研究语料，而这些任务并不需要它。
+
+第十五与第十六份记录是第一个离线折叠，即尝试次数上限假设：同样九个第 3 层环境与两次重复，作为两支舰队各运行一次，两者只在把运行器的尝试次数从三次限制为一次的组合叠加层上不同，然后由基准的折叠驱动折成与实验相同的配对证书率差值（[folds/2026-09-08-e3-attempts1-against-baseline-t3.json](folds/2026-09-08-e3-attempts1-against-baseline-t3.json)）。两支舰队都以第一次尝试认证了 18 之 18 个单元，因此差值为 0，区间为 [0, 0]，这个折叠对尝试次数没有任何说明：基线从未用到第二或第三次尝试，而在没有任何超出首次的尝试被使用之处，尝试上限不可能显示出效应。真正用到多次尝试的是第 5 层，第十一份记录中 harness 循环有三个单元在第二次尝试获得认证；尝试上限的比较属于那里，排在预算对等切片之后。
+
+第十四份记录是第三个冻结配对实验：以最大的产品模型为候选臂、中等模型为基线臂，同样九个第 3 层环境与 harness 循环，36 个单元，用时 3,024 s。两臂都认证了 18 之 18 个单元，因此就证书而言这一层第三次得到不确定的结论；基线臂这次有两个单元需要第二次尝试，而它之前的运行一次都不需要，这正是配对设计所吸收的运行间波动。在其他每一项度量上，最大的模型都是更省的实现者：156 个模型步骤（对方 208），单元用时合计 2,070 s（对方 3,948，中位数 118 s 对 165 s），输出 token 166,606 个（对方 367,172），缓存写入 token 2,071,448 个（对方 3,635,010）。综合第十三与第十四份记录，三个产品模型按花费而非按证书排序：最大的模型在 harness 循环上花费最少，因为它走的步骤最少，而这条路由的每一步都要重写前缀。
+
+第十三份记录是第二个冻结配对实验，即 harness 循环上的模型层级比较：同样九个第 3 层环境，每个重复两次，以较小的产品模型为候选臂、中等模型为基线臂，共 36 个单元，用时 5,437 s。两臂都以第一次尝试认证了 18 之 18 个单元，因此差值再次为 0，区间为 [0, 0]，结论为不确定：就这一层的证书而言，较小的模型并不更差。其他一切都把两个层级区分开来：较小的模型需要 405 个模型步骤（对方 182），单元用时合计 6,719 s（对方 3,807，单元中位数 300 s 对 207 s），输出 token 844,538 个（对方 358,054），缓存写入 token 9,985,537 个（对方 3,070,990）。与第八份记录合读，就证书而言，基准的第 3 层对这三个产品模型在两种循环下都已饱和，模型之间与循环之间的差异体现在步骤、墙上时间与花费上。
+
+第十二份记录是产品自身循环在同样八个第 5 层环境上的运行，也是第一个其单元携带子进程所报告模型、用量与费用的委派舰队：十六个单元，11 个获认证，每张证书都在第一次尝试取得，同时运行两个单元共用时 8,139 s，报告的输出 token 为 1,300,589 个，报告的按目录价计算的费用为 31.48 美元。证书落点与第十一份记录中 harness 循环完全一致：同样六个环境各认证两次，lex-states 一次，conf-canon 与 sheet-eval 从未认证，且未过之处停在同样的角落（conf-canon 每次尝试都停在 144 之 150，harness 循环为 146；lex-states 158 之 160，对方为 159），这既指向两种实现者，也同样指向这些角落的规范本身。两者在其他方面有差异：harness 循环需要三次第二次尝试之处，产品自身循环一次也不需要；其获认证单元用时 232 至 555 s，harness 循环为 150 至 599 s；其未过单元不受上限约束，最长运行 3,459 s、单个花费 5.60 美元，因为组合的墙上时间上限只约束 harness 自己的步骤（预算对等切片已排入队列），而 harness 循环的未过单元在 1,200,000 ms 上限处被截断。harness 循环的 16 个单元花费 860,596 个输出 token，产品自身循环为 1,300,589 个；harness 循环有 4,778,361 个缓存写入 token，而产品自身循环的用量以缓存读取为主。
+
+第十一份记录是 harness 循环在第 5 层上的运行，这一层由实现者永远看不到的用例来裁定：未被保留的八个第 5 层环境，十六个单元，11 个获认证（8 个在第一次尝试，3 个在第二次），同时运行两个单元共用时 5,117 s，平均每个单元 16.9 个模型步骤，860,596 个输出 token，745,264 个缓存读取与 4,778,361 个缓存写入 token。这一层能够区分：五次未过分为两类。三次是聚类指令没有把模型引向的规范角落（conf-canon 两次都在每次尝试停在 146 之 150 个用例，四个失败全在 stderr 通道；lex-states 一次在每次尝试停在 159 之 160）。两次是预算耗尽：在 sheet-eval 上，第一次尝试在写出非常大的模块时就已超过组合的 1,200,000 ms 墙上时间上限；在 conf-canon 上，第一次尝试在达到 146 之 150 之后同样如此，于是预算策略在模型能够依据指令行动之前就阻止了其余尝试。路由的每步成本在两类情形中都可见：每一步都是一个新的产品会话，突破墙上时间上限的两次未过在第一次尝试中分别花了 12 步与 35 步。
+
+第十份记录完成了 harness 循环对第 2 至 4 层的一遍运行：九个第 4 层环境，十八个单元，每个都在一次尝试内获得认证，每个单元 68 至 293 s，中位数 175 s，同时运行两个单元共用时 1467 s，平均每个单元 13.2 个模型步骤，214,397 个输出 token，655,134 个缓存读取与 4,024,446 个缓存写入 token。在这一层上产品自身循环是更快的实现者：与第六份记录逐单元对照，harness 循环在 18 对中只有 6 对更快，其单元合计用时 2915 s，对方为 2292 s。第 4 层交给实现者的是一个带预埋缺陷的模块，harness 循环在其上花费的短步骤比其他层更多；而每一步都是一个新的产品进程，把整个前缀重新写入缓存，墙上时间与缓存写入 token 都耗在这里。三层合计，两种实现者都以每个一次尝试认证了 48 之 48 个单元，harness 循环在第 2、3 层更快，在第 4 层更慢。
+
+第九份记录是 harness 循环在第四份记录用产品自身循环测过的同六个第 2 层环境上的舰队运行：十二个单元，每个都在一次尝试内获得认证，每个单元 37 至 481 s，中位数 116 s，同时运行两个单元共用时 979 s，平均每个单元 7.6 个模型步骤，158,899 个输出 token，255,502 个缓存读取与 884,168 个缓存写入 token。与第四份记录逐单元对照（同一环境与同一重复，但来自不同舰队而非同一个冻结计划），harness 循环在 12 对中的 9 对更快，其单元合计用时 1786 s，产品自身循环为 1932 s。
+
+第八份记录是假设计划的第一个冻结配对实验（摘要 `4c9659e3…`）：以 harness 自身在 Claude Code 路由上的循环为基线臂，以产品自身的循环为候选臂，两侧使用同一个模型，覆盖未被保留的九个第 3 层环境，每个重复两次，种子 1，共 36 个单元，同时运行两个单元共用时 4194 s。两臂都以每个一次尝试认证了 18 之 18 个单元，因此证书率之差为 0，自助区间为 [0, 0]，在 0.05 的最小差值下结论为不确定：在这一层上，就证书而言 harness 循环既不优于也不劣于产品循环，这驳斥了"harness 循环在这些任务上输给产品循环"的假设，也不支持"它胜出"的假设。墙上时间同样持平：harness 循环在 18 对中的 11 对更快，其单元中位数为 164 s，对方为 179 s，两臂总计相差不到百分之一。harness 循环的花费有据可查，因为它的查询经过 harness：200 次查询共 352,494 个输出 token 与 553,676 个缓存读取 token，但缓存写入 token 达 3,005,288 个，因为每次查询都新开一个产品会话，其前缀被再次写入缓存而不是从缓存读取；产品循环每个单元只保持一个会话，这笔开销只付一次。产品臂的花费不在这份记录中：把单元模型转发给子进程并记录其报告用量与费用的切片是在运行开始后才合并的（清单的头部包含它，运行本身不包含），因此下一个配对实验将同时记录两臂的花费。
+
+第七份记录是 harness 自身的循环在 Claude Code 路由上认证的第一个单元，紧接在该路由开始以原生方式提供 harness 工具之后：五次模型查询，五次工具调用（探索、读测试、读桩、写模块、跑测试套件），没有重试，一次验证，从标记到证书 41 s，输出 2580 个 token。同一个环境在第四份记录中由产品自身循环完成用了 59 与 63 s。在这次路由变更之前，同一个单元的每次查询都在产品的轮次上限处失败，该路由的说明记录了这一点。
+
+第六份记录完成了产品自身循环对整个基准的一遍运行：未被保留的九个第 4 层环境，十八个单元，每个都在一次尝试内获得认证，每个单元 58 至 235 s，同时运行两个单元共用时 1151 s。第 4 层交给实现者的是一个带有预埋缺陷的现成模块和一套不可变的测试，因此其单元比第 3 层更快。三次舰队合计，产品自身循环以每个一次尝试认证了 48 之 48 个单元，因此就证书而言，这个基准在任何层上都无法为这个产品模型区分实现者；基准的下一个切片是更高的一层与六个保留环境，而在此之下的每一项比较都读取尝试次数、墙上时间和花费。
+
+第五份记录是同一份舰队计划在未被保留的九个第 3 层环境上的运行：十八个单元，每个都在一次尝试内获得认证，每个单元 71 至 389 s，同时运行两个单元共用时 1844 s。因此在这个基准上，第 3 层对产品自身循环同样是天花板；只计数证书的比较在第 4 层以下无法区分实现者，在这些层上能够区分的度量是尝试次数、墙上时间和花费，其中委派记录已保存前两项，排队中的切片落地后将保存子进程报告的花费。
+
+第四份记录是 Proving Ground 基准（`examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/`，三十个已通过准入的程序任务）的第一次舰队运行：每个单元都由产品自身的循环实现，覆盖未被保留的六个第 2 层环境，每个重复两次，种子 1，策略 `bench-2026-09-07`，区 `bench-h1`，同时运行两个单元，十二个单元共用时 984 s。每个单元都在一次尝试内获得认证，因此第 2 层对这个实现者而言是天花板，harness 循环与产品循环之间的配对比较在第 3 层和第 4 层进行。单元上标注的模型是 `sonnet`；由于委派尚未把单元的模型转发给子进程（转发它并记录子进程所报告模型的切片已排入队列），产品运行的是安装的默认模型，该默认值在运行前被测得为 sonnet。基准的组合与任务对应提交 `128e037bb`；清单记录的是记录时工作树的头部。
+
+第三份记录是同一个区整夜运行的结果：从 22:16 到 09:16 UTC，按三十分钟的节奏运行了 22 个时槽，其中包括第二份记录所保存的第一个时槽。宿主机重启过一次；应在 00:16 开启的时槽没有被补跑，与班次驱动器的节奏规则所述完全一致，重新启动的进程从 00:46 起在当时的工作树上沿用同一份账本和同一节奏继续，因此重启前的时槽运行的是 `88f6a1f2e` 处的树，重启后的时槽运行的是 `38dd04165` 处的树，manifest 记录的 head 即为后者。66 个 cell 全部在一次尝试内获得认证；该记录保存了全部 22 份班次账本、66 个 cell 会话，以及在它们之上折叠出的导出。
+
+第二次运行是实时区在修复了它自己暴露出的两个缺陷之后的第一个时槽：一个被此版本 Node 拒绝的测试检查，以及一个在验证前把整个 fixture 覆盖回去、从而丢弃了对 fixture 所提供源文件的一切改动的 runner。三个各自带有不可变测试套件的程序任务，由该产品各以一次尝试实现，并由 runner 在它留下的目录树上认证；被留出的任务从未进入计划。
+
+第一次运行是 Proving Ground 首次测量 harness 自身以外的 agent：两个 smoke 环境处于 `isolation: none`，每次尝试一个子运行并记录为 `environment/delegation`，每次委托都以 `completed` 结束，两个会话的事实都已导出，两条 trajectory 都经 curator 导出且其中一条获得奖励，observatory 在 `claude-code` 实现者下发布了两行，已认证的那一行以 `runner` 作为证书执行者。

+# Proving Ground runs
+
+English | [中文](README.zh.md)
+
+Records of real Proving Ground runs: the district's certified measurements of one implementer on registered environments, kept exactly as the harness folded and exported them. A run directory is the output of one fleet plan: the cell session logs, the exported session facts, the curator-gated trajectory export, the observatory snapshot and page, the driver's report, and a manifest with every file's digest. Nothing in a run directory is edited after the run; the table below is read from those files.
+
+## Layout
+
+```
+data/proving-ground/
+  <date>-<implementer>-run-<n>/
+    manifest.json        repository head, composition, implementer, session ids, per-file bytes and SHA-256
+    result.json          the driver's report: fleet report, delegation records, export reports, observatory document
+    facts.jsonl          scorekeeper facts, one per cell session
+    trajectories.jsonl   curator-gated trajectory export, one per exported session
+    observatory.json     the observatory snapshot the page was rendered from
+    observatory.html     the rendered observatory page
+    sessions/            the cell session logs, one JSONL file per cell, named by session id
+  folds/<date>-<candidate>-against-<baseline>-<tier>.json   an offline paired fold of two recorded fleets that differ by a composition overlay, or a counterfactual of one recorded fleet re-read under a cap
+  folds/<date>-<reading>-<tier>-seed<seed>.json             an offline reading over recorded arms that share a tier and seed: the routing reading (oracle and cascades over single-model arms) or the repeatability of one arm across its runs
+  dashboard.html                                            the Proving Ground dashboard, one self-contained page folded from every record and fold above by tools/build-dashboard.mjs
+```
+
+## Running one
+
+A run is a Loader-booted composition under `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/` driven from an empty directory outside the repository; the driver creates the session store there and writes the exports next to it. The first run used the composition below, with the host's own Claude Code installation and account as the implementer of every cell:
+
+```sh
+mkdir -p /tmp/proving-ground-run && cd /tmp/proving-ground-run
+REPO=/path/to/deepseek-harness
+TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$REPO/tsconfig.json node --import $REPO/node_modules/tsx/dist/esm/index.mjs $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/driver.ts $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/cordis.yml > stdout.jsonl
+```
+
+Then record it, which copies the exports, every session log, and the driver's result into a new run directory, writes its `manifest.json` with the repository head, the composition, the implementers read from the run stamps, and every file's digest, and refuses to overwrite a recorded run; add a row below afterwards:
+
+```sh
+node data/proving-ground/tools/record-run.mjs /tmp/proving-ground-run 2026-09-06-claude-code-run-2 --composition examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/cordis.yml
+```
+
+A live district (`examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/`) is recorded the same way from the directory its driver runs in, one slot per run directory: the shift ledger session lands beside the cell sessions and `result.json` holds the driver's status.
+
+## What a row proves
+
+A delegated cell's certificate proves that the runner authored the standard before any work started, restored the immutable paths from the fixture over the tree the external agent left, found the check-owned set unchanged, and ran the checks itself. It proves nothing about how the work was done: the external agent's prompts, tool calls, and reasoning stay in its own product, so the cell session holds the stamp, the standard, the delegation records, the runs, and the certificate, and no assistant turn. The exported trajectory therefore carries no step. It is a measurement, not training data, and the `implementer` field on the stamp is what a curated export filters on. The [external implementer note](../../.agents/notes/proposed/architecture/2026-09-06-external-implementer.md) owns these rules.
+
+## What a cell reached outside its workspace

The middle model certified 14 of 16 (9 at the first attempt, five at the second, sheet-eval missed twice after three attempts); the smallest certified 1 of 16, ranked-choice once at the first attempt, and spent all three attempts on every other cell, delta −0.8125, interval [−0.875, −0.75], verdict reject: at tier 5 the smallest model is not an implementer for these tasks, where at tier 3 it was level on certificates. It was also the most expensive arm on record: 604 model steps against 262, 11,227 s of cell time against 6,337 (median 725 s against 297), 736,856 output tokens against 481,591, 1,077,050 cache-write tokens against 669,507 and 21,275,855 cache-read against 7,633,594, because a cell that fails three times rereads its growing transcript three times over. Read with the twentieth record, the three product models order strictly on every cell: no cell the smallest certified was missed by the middle one, and none the middle one certified was missed by the largest, so the offline routing reading over the three single-model arms ([folds/2026-09-08-routing-t5-seed2.json](folds/2026-09-08-routing-t5-seed2.json)) is exact rather than estimated. The oracle that picks the cheapest certifying model per cell is the largest model alone (16 of 16, 189,169 output tokens, 164 steps, 3,572 s), and so is the strong-first cascade; the cheap-first cascade over all three reaches 16 of 16 at 1,248,222 output tokens and 18,028 s, 6.6 and 5.0 times the largest model alone; the middle-then-largest cascade at 525,564 tokens and 7,006 s, 2.8 and 2.0 times. Every cascade that starts below the largest model pays the smaller model's whole failure before it escalates, so on this bench the routing question is not which model to try first but whether a hard cell can be told apart before any model runs, and nothing in the stamp tells it apart. The three runs of the middle model on these cells also give the bench its noise floor ([folds/2026-09-08-sonnet-repeatability-t5-seed2.json](folds/2026-09-08-sonnet-repeatability-t5-seed2.json)): the two sealed runs (this record and the twentieth) agree on 15 of 16 cells, one flip; each agrees with the unsealed eighteenth on 14 and 13 of 16, where conf-canon certified twice in both sealed runs and never in the unsealed one. A paired delta of 0.0625 on sixteen cells is therefore within one arm's own run-to-run variation, and the twentieth's 0.1875 is three times it. The census finds seven cells naming their parent or the run directory in twelve tool calls; every such call saw the empty sealed directory, and no read was denied.
+
+The twentieth record is the first frozen paired experiment on the sealed bench and the first whose interval excludes zero: the middle product model as the baseline arm against the largest as the candidate, on the harness loop, over the eight audited tier-5 environments, seed 2, two repetitions, 32 cells, 5,742 s of wall time at two cells at a time, under the composition that confines every cell with bwrap (a cell's parent directory is an empty tmpfs holding only the cell), resumes one product session per harness session, and forwards each hidden case's arguments through the reserved check script. The largest model certified 16 of 16 at the first attempt; the middle one 13 of 16 (11 at the first attempt, diff3-merge and rate-limit-sim once each at the second, sheet-eval missed twice at the 1,200,000 ms wall cap and lex-states once after three attempts), delta 0.1875, interval [0.125, 0.25], verdict promote at the 0.05 minimum delta: on these tasks the largest model is the better implementer, and the difference sits where the specification has corners the middle model does not reach in three attempts. The largest model was also the cheaper and faster arm on every measure: 164 model steps against 267, 3,572 s of cell time against 7,451 (median 204 s against 387), 189,169 output tokens against 561,271, and with session continuity now on the route the spend is read-dominant, 2,185,841 cache-read against 317,394 cache-write tokens for the candidate and 8,515,603 against 738,281 for the baseline, where the eighteenth record's harness loop wrote 2,927,150 and read 626,621. The census finds seven cells that named the run directory or their parent in eight tool calls; under the seal every such call saw an empty directory holding only the cell's own workspace, as the recorded results show, and no read was denied because nothing reachable was denied. This is the first promotion-level verdict of the program and it promotes a model, not a change to the harness; read with the thirteenth and fourteenth records it says the model tiers separate on certificates at tier 5 where tier 3 saturated, and it says nothing yet about the harness loop against the product loop, whose sealed rerun follows.
+
+The nineteenth record is the harness assessing itself through its own program workflow: one department on the route, the largest product model, reading an eleven-file evidence dossier in its worktree (this README, the census, the record index, the last thirty hours of commits, the slate, the roles matrix, the sealed-cell note, the ruflo and baselines comparisons, and the question with the four goals) and writing `assessment.md`, certified by a committed verifier that requires four named sections, two verdict lines, at least eight evidence bullets each citing a dossier file that exists, six distinct files, and 600 to 2,500 words; the integration re-ran the verifier on the merged head. The department certified at its first validation after eleven steps (14 evidence bullets, 9 files cited, 2,258 words) with `Viable: undetermined (medium confidence)` and `State of the art: in part (medium confidence)`, the part being the measurement instrument and its enforcement rather than any measured capability; it also found that this lab's own summary table carries no contamination column and that the tier 2 to 4 comparisons are folds of separate fleets, not frozen experiments. The run exposed three defects in the program workflow, all kept in the artefacts directory beside the record ([2026-09-08-self-assessment-program-artefacts/manifest.json](2026-09-08-self-assessment-program-artefacts/manifest.json)): the department certified with the file written but never committed, so the integration merged an empty branch and failed on `missing assessment.md`; the integration agent, unconfined, then found the department's worktree and rewrote sentences of the certified file with a script before the operator stopped it after 22 steps; and the resume refused to republish the integration session's identity, so the operator committed the department tree as it then stood, set the first integration session aside, and resumed, after which the integration certified the merged head and the program released. The text the department certified is reconstructed byte for byte from its own session's write (`assessment.certified.md`, 2,258 words) and differs from the merged text in five lines, none of them a verdict.
+
+The eighteenth record is the fourth frozen paired experiment and the tier-5 form of the eighth: the harness loop as the baseline arm against the product loop as the candidate arm, the same product model on both sides, on the eight tier-5 environments as audited (the conf-canon reference and six of its cases regenerated, the lex-states and sheet-eval prompts clarified), seed 2, two repetitions, 32 cells, 8,979 s of wall time at two cells at a time. The harness loop certified 12 of 16 (9 at the first attempt, 3 at the second: diff3-merge, lex-states, and rate-limit-sim once each), the product loop 11 of 16 (10 at the first attempt and rate-limit-sim once at the second, the first recovery by a fresh child that received the directive alone), delta −0.0625, interval [−0.125, 0], verdict inconclusive. Three cells flip between the arms: the product loop certified conf-canon once where the harness loop never did, and the harness loop certified uri-resolve twice where the product loop's two cells failed three delegations each in 125 s with no reported model or cost, because they ran last, after 04:10 UTC, when the subscription's session limit had been reached (it reset at 05:30); on the 14 pairs the limit did not touch, the arms differ by one certificate in the product loop's favour. Both arms miss sheet-eval twice, the harness loop cut at the 1,200,000 ms wall cap and the product loop uncapped at 662 and 714 s, because in this run the composition's caps bound only the harness's own steps (the budget-parity slice landed after it). The product loop was the faster implementer, faster in 10 of 16 pairs, 7,554 s of cell time against 10,221, and reported 629,483 output tokens and 13.23 USD of list-price cost; the harness loop's 16 cells spent 802,872 output tokens, 626,621 cache-read and 2,927,150 cache-write tokens, with one transient route retry on each conf-canon cell that recovered. This record also carries the defect a census found after it: five of the harness loop's sixteen cells left their workspace for the run directory, read its plan and log and a sibling cell of their own environment (lex-states, rate-limit-sim, and conf-canon of the second repetition, and both sheet-eval cells), and the first sheet-eval cell did its work inside the second's workspace, while no product-loop cell left its own; the sealed-cell slice that denies a cell everything above its workspace is queued, and the tier-5 comparison is rerun under it before this verdict is read as more than what it is. Read with the eleventh and twelfth records, tier 5 does not separate the two loops on certificates either: both land at 11 or 12 of 16 on the same environments, with the misses on the same two tasks.
+
+A counterfactual fold of the eleventh and twelfth records, written before the confirmatory pair at tier 5 runs, carries the attempt-cap hypothesis to the tier where attempts are taken ([folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-harness-loop-t5.json](folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-harness-loop-t5.json), [folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-product-loop-t5.json](folds/2026-09-08-attempts1-counterfactual-against-product-loop-t5.json)): each cell's outcome is replaced by the outcome of its first attempt alone, which is what the same run would have recorded under a cap of one attempt, since a first attempt cannot observe the attempts after it. On the harness loop the cap costs 3 of 11 certificates (`code:diff3-merge` twice and `code:lex-states` once, all recovered at the second attempt after a directive), delta −0.1875, interval [−0.25, −0.125], verdict reject for the capped candidate; on the product loop the cap costs nothing, delta 0, interval [0, 0], because none of its five failed cells recovered in a second or third attempt, and the delegation is why: a later attempt of a delegated cell starts a fresh child that receives the directive alone, without the task prompt or the earlier child's transcript, where a later attempt of the harness loop continues the same transcript with the task, its own work, and the directive in view. The two loops' later attempts are therefore not the same instrument, and the attempt-ladder slice that restates the task to a fresh child and names the transcript interface of every attempt is queued before the tier-5 rerun. The two intervals resample the 16 cells of one run each and carry no run-to-run variance, so they are narrower than a paired run's would be; the paired attempt-cap fleet on the audited tier-5 tasks is the confirmatory step, and until it lands this fold is evidence that the runner's directives convert failures on the harness loop and could not on the product loop as delegated today, not a promotion.
+
+The seventeenth record is the knowledge-pack fold, the same nine tier-3 environments and two repetitions run with the composition overlay that serves the eight-theme 2026-q3 knowledge pack as the session's skill catalog, folded against the fifteenth record's baseline ([folds/2026-09-08-e4-knowledge-pack-against-baseline-t3.json](folds/2026-09-08-e4-knowledge-pack-against-baseline-t3.json)): 18 of 18 certified at the first attempt on both sides, delta 0, interval [0, 0]. The pack was never opened: the catalog of 2,778 characters stood in every request and no cell made a skill call, so this fold measures a catalog the model reads and ignores, not knowledge in use. The fleet's cells took 5,433 s against the baseline's 3,959 and 482,920 output tokens against 339,331, more than the four other sonnet tier-3 fleets on record (339,331 to 367,172); one fleet cannot say whether the catalog or run-to-run variance caused it. The hypothesis the pack was built to test, that task-relevant knowledge served as skills changes outcomes, needs a pack whose themes the tasks call for; this pack holds the research corpus, and these tasks do not call for it.
+
+The fifteenth and sixteenth records are the first offline fold, the attempt-cap hypothesis: the same nine tier-3 environments and two repetitions run twice as fleets that differ only by the composition overlay that caps the runner at one attempt instead of three, then folded by the bench's fold driver into the same paired certificate-rate delta an experiment computes ([folds/2026-09-08-e3-attempts1-against-baseline-t3.json](folds/2026-09-08-e3-attempts1-against-baseline-t3.json)). Both fleets certified 18 of 18 at the first attempt, so the delta is 0 with interval [0, 0] and the fold says nothing about attempts: the baseline never used its second or third attempt, and a cap on attempts cannot show an effect where no attempt beyond the first is taken. The tier where attempts were taken is tier 5, where the eleventh record's harness loop certified three cells at the second attempt; the attempt-cap comparison belongs there and is queued behind the budget-parity slice.
+
+The fourteenth record is the third frozen paired experiment, the largest product model as the candidate arm against the middle one, on the same nine tier-3 environments and the harness loop: 36 cells, 3,024 s of wall time. Both arms certified 18 of 18, so the verdict is inconclusive on certificates for the third time on this tier, and the baseline arm needed a second attempt on two cells this time where its earlier runs needed none, which is the run-to-run variance a paired design absorbs. The largest model was the cheaper implementer on every other measure: 156 model steps against 208, 2,070 s of cell time against 3,948 (median 118 s against 165), 166,606 output tokens against 367,172, and 2,071,448 cache-write tokens against 3,635,010. Across the thirteenth and fourteenth records the three product models order by spend, not by certificates: the largest spends the least on the harness loop because it takes the fewest steps, and every step of this route rewrites the prefix.
+
+The thirteenth record is the second frozen paired experiment, the model-tier comparison on the harness loop: the same nine tier-3 environments, two repetitions, the smaller product model as the candidate arm against the middle one as the baseline, 36 cells, 5,437 s of wall time. Both arms certified 18 of 18 at the first attempt, so the delta is again 0 with interval [0, 0] and the verdict inconclusive: on certificates at this tier the smaller model is not worse. Everything else separates the tiers: the smaller model needed 405 model steps against 182, 6,719 s of cell time against 3,807 (its median cell 300 s against 207), 844,538 output tokens against 358,054, and 9,985,537 cache-write tokens against 3,070,990. Read with the eighth record, the bench's tier 3 is saturated on certificates for all three of these product models under both loops, and the differences between models and between loops live in steps, wall time, and spend.
+
+The twelfth record is the product loop on the same eight tier-5 environments, the first delegated fleet whose cells carry the child's reported model, usage, and cost: sixteen cells, 11 certified, every certificate at the first attempt, 8,139 s of wall time at two cells at a time, 1,300,589 reported output tokens and 31.48 USD of reported list-price cost for the fleet. The certificates fall exactly where the harness loop's did in the eleventh record: the same six environments certified twice, lex-states once, conf-canon and sheet-eval never, and the misses stop at the same corners (conf-canon 144 of 150 on every attempt against the harness loop's 146, lex-states 158 of 160 against 159), which points at the specifications of those corners as much as at either implementer. The two implementers differ elsewhere: the product loop needed no second attempt where the harness loop needed three, its certified cells took 232 to 555 s against the harness loop's 150 to 599 s, and its misses ran uncapped for up to 3,459 s and 5.60 USD each because the composition's wall cap binds only the harness's own steps (the budget-parity slice is queued), where the harness loop's misses were cut at the 1,200,000 ms cap. The harness loop's 16 cells cost 860,596 output tokens against the product loop's 1,300,589, and 4,778,361 cache-write tokens against the product loop's read-dominant profile.
+
+The eleventh record is the harness loop on tier 5, the tier judged on cases the implementer never sees: the eight tier-5 environments that are not held out, sixteen cells, 11 certified (8 at the first attempt, 3 at the second), 5,117 s of wall time at two cells at a time, 16.9 model steps per cell on average, 860,596 output tokens, 745,264 cache-read and 4,778,361 cache-write tokens. The tier separates: the five misses are two kinds. Three are specification corners the clustered directive did not lead the model to (conf-canon twice at 146 of 150 cases on every attempt, all four on the stderr channel; lex-states once at 159 of 160 on every attempt). Two are budget exhaustion: on sheet-eval the first attempt alone ran past the composition's 1,200,000 ms wall cap while writing very large modules, and on conf-canon the first attempt did the same after reaching 146 of 150, so the budget policy blocked the remaining attempts before the model could act on the directive. The route's per-step cost is visible in both kinds: every step is a fresh product session, and the two misses that breached the wall cap spent 12 and 35 steps on their first attempt.
+
+The tenth record completes the harness loop's pass over tiers 2 to 4: the nine tier-4 environments, eighteen cells, every one certified in one attempt, 68 to 293 s per cell, median 175 s, 1467 s of wall time at two cells at a time, 13.2 model steps per cell on average, 214,397 output tokens, 655,134 cache-read and 4,024,446 cache-write tokens. On this tier the product loop was the faster implementer: set against the sixth record cell by cell, the harness loop was faster in 6 of 18 pairs and its cells took 2915 s in total against 2292 s. Tier 4 hands the implementer a module with planted defects, and the harness loop spends more short steps on it than on the other tiers; every step is a fresh product process that rewrites the whole prefix into the cache, which is where both the wall time and the cache-write tokens go. Across the three tiers both implementers certified 48 of 48 cells at one attempt each, the harness loop faster on tiers 2 and 3 and slower on tier 4.
+
+The ninth record is the harness loop's fleet over the same six tier-2 environments the fourth record measured with the product loop: twelve cells, every one certified in one attempt, 37 to 481 s per cell, median 116 s, 979 s of wall time at two cells at a time, 7.6 model steps per cell on average, 158,899 output tokens, 255,502 cache-read and 884,168 cache-write tokens. Set beside the fourth record cell by cell (the same environment and repetition, in different fleets rather than one frozen plan), the harness loop was faster in 9 of 12 pairs and its cells took 1786 s in total against the product loop's 1932 s.
+
+The eighth record is the first frozen paired experiment of the hypothesis program (digest `4c9659e3…`): the harness's own loop on the Claude Code route as the baseline arm against the product's own loop as the candidate arm, the same model on both sides, over the nine tier-3 environments that are not held out, two repetitions, seed 1, 36 cells, 4194 s of wall time at two cells at a time. Both arms certified 18 of 18 cells at one attempt each, so the certificate-rate delta is 0 with a bootstrap interval of [0, 0] and the verdict is inconclusive at the 0.05 minimum delta: on this tier the harness loop is neither better nor worse than the product loop on certificates, which refutes the hypothesis that the harness loop loses to the product loop on these tasks and does not support the hypothesis that it wins. Wall time is also level: the harness loop was faster in 11 of the 18 pairs, its median cell took 164 s against 179 s, and the two arms' totals differ by under one percent. The harness loop's spend is on record because its queries go through the harness: 352,494 output tokens and 553,676 cache-read tokens over 200 queries, but 3,005,288 cache-write tokens, because every query opens a fresh product session whose prefix is written to the cache again instead of read from it; the product loop keeps one session per cell and pays that once. The product arm's spend is not on this record: the slice that forwards the cell's model to the child and records the child's reported usage and cost merged after the run had started (the manifest's head carries it, the runs do not), so the next paired experiment carries both arms' spend.
+
+The seventh record is the first cell the harness's own loop certified on the Claude Code route, immediately after the route began offering the harness tools natively: five model queries, five tool calls (explore, read the tests, read the stub, write the module, run the suite), no retry, one validation, 41 s from stamp to certificate, 2580 output tokens. The same environment took the product loop 59 and 63 s in the fourth record. Before that route change the same cell failed every query at the product's turn bound, which the route's note records.
+
+The sixth record completes the product loop's pass over the bench: the nine tier-4 environments that are not held out, eighteen cells, every one certified in one attempt, 58 to 235 s per cell, 1151 s of wall time at two cells at a time. Tier 4 hands the implementer an existing module with planted defects and an immutable suite, which is why its cells are faster than tier 3's. Across the three fleets the product loop certified 48 of 48 cells at one attempt each, so on certificates this bench does not separate implementers at any tier for this product model; the bench's next slice is a harder tier and the six held-out environments, and every comparison below that reads attempts, wall time, and spend.
+
+The fifth record is the same fleet plan on the nine tier-3 environments that are not held out: eighteen cells, every one certified in one attempt, 71 to 389 s per cell, 1844 s of wall time at two cells at a time. Tier 3 is therefore also a ceiling for the product loop on this bench, and a comparison that only counts certificates cannot separate implementers below tier 4; the separating measures at these tiers are attempts, wall time, and spend, of which the delegation record holds the first two and will hold the child's reported spend once the queued slice lands.
+
+The fourth record is the Proving Ground bench's first fleet (`examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/`, thirty admitted program tasks): the product's own loop as the implementer of every cell, over the six tier-2 environments that are not held out, two repetitions each, seed 1, policy `bench-2026-09-07`, district `bench-h1`, two cells at a time, 984 s of wall time for the twelve cells. Every cell was certified in one attempt, so tier 2 is a ceiling for this implementer and the paired comparisons between the harness loop and the product loop run on tiers 3 and 4. The cells name the model `sonnet`; the product ran the installation's default model, which was measured as sonnet immediately before the run, because the delegation did not yet forward the cell's model to the child (the slice that forwards it and records the child's reported model is queued). The bench composition and tasks are those of commit `128e037bb`; the manifest records the head of the working tree at recording time.
+
+The third record is the same district left running overnight: 22 slots on its thirty-minute cadence from 22:16 to 09:16 UTC, including the first slot the second record holds. The host restarted once; the slot due at 00:16 was not caught up, exactly as the shift driver's cadence rule states, and the relaunched process resumed the same ledger and cadence from 00:46 on the working tree of that moment, so the slots before the restart ran the tree at `88f6a1f2e` and the slots after it the tree at `38dd04165`, which the manifest records as the head. Every one of the 66 cells was certified in one attempt; the record holds all 22 shift ledgers, the 66 cell sessions, and the exports folded over them.
+
+The second run is the live district's first slot after two defects the district itself exposed were fixed: a test check this Node rejected, and a runner that overlaid the whole fixture before validation and so discarded every edit to a fixture-supplied source file. Three program tasks, each with an immutable test suite, were implemented by the product in one attempt each and certified by the runner on the trees it left; the held-out task never entered the plan.
+
+The first run is the first time an agent other than the harness itself was measured by the Proving Ground: two smoke environments at `isolation: none`, one child run per attempt recorded as `environment/delegation`, every delegation ending `completed`, facts exported for both sessions, both trajectories exported through the curator with one rewarded, and the observatory publishing both rows under the `claude-code` implementer with `runner` as the certificate executor of the certified one.

lines: ## 一个 cell 在自己工作区之外触及了什么

+# Proving Ground 运行记录
+
+[English](README.md) | 中文
+
+真实 Proving Ground 运行的记录：该区对一个实现者（implementer）在已注册环境上的经认证测量，完全按 harness 折叠和导出的原样保存。一个运行目录就是一次 fleet 计划的输出：cell 会话日志、导出的会话事实、经 curator 把关的 trajectory 导出、observatory 快照与页面、驱动器的报告，以及带有每个文件摘要的 manifest。运行目录中的任何内容在运行之后都不再编辑；下表由这些文件读出。
+
+## Layout
+
+```
+data/proving-ground/
+  <date>-<implementer>-run-<n>/
+    manifest.json        repository head, composition, implementer, session ids, per-file bytes and SHA-256
+    result.json          the driver's report: fleet report, delegation records, export reports, observatory document
+    facts.jsonl          scorekeeper facts, one per cell session
+    trajectories.jsonl   curator-gated trajectory export, one per exported session
+    observatory.json     the observatory snapshot the page was rendered from
+    observatory.html     the rendered observatory page
+    sessions/            the cell session logs, one JSONL file per cell, named by session id
+  folds/<date>-<candidate>-against-<baseline>-<tier>.json   an offline paired fold of two recorded fleets that differ by a composition overlay, or a counterfactual of one recorded fleet re-read under a cap
+  folds/<date>-<reading>-<tier>-seed<seed>.json             an offline reading over recorded arms that share a tier and seed: the routing reading (oracle and cascades over single-model arms) or the repeatability of one arm across its runs
+  dashboard.html                                            the Proving Ground dashboard, one self-contained page folded from every record and fold above by tools/build-dashboard.mjs
+```
+
+## 运行一次
+
+一次运行是 `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/` 下的一个由 Loader 启动的组合，从仓库之外的一个空目录驱动；驱动器在那里创建会话存储，并把导出写在它旁边。第一次运行使用了下面的组合，以宿主机自己的 Claude Code 安装和账户作为每个 cell 的实现者：
+
+```sh
+mkdir -p /tmp/proving-ground-run && cd /tmp/proving-ground-run
+REPO=/path/to/deepseek-harness
+TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$REPO/tsconfig.json node --import $REPO/node_modules/tsx/dist/esm/index.mjs $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/driver.ts $REPO/examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-claude-implementer/cordis.yml > stdout.jsonl
+```
+
+然后记录它：该工具把导出、每份会话日志和驱动器的结果复制到一个新的运行目录，写出带有仓库 head、组合、从运行 stamp 读出的实现者以及每个文件摘要的 `manifest.json`，并拒绝覆盖已记录的运行；之后再在下表中加一行：
+
+```sh
+node data/proving-ground/tools/record-run.mjs /tmp/proving-ground-run 2026-09-06-claude-code-run-2 --composition examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/cordis.yml
+```
+
+实时区（`examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/village-live/`）以同样方式从其驱动器运行所在的目录记录，每个时槽一个运行目录：班次账本会话与 cell 会话并排落地，`result.json` 保存驱动器的状态。
+
+## 一行证明了什么
+
+一个被委托的 cell 的证书证明：runner 在任何工作开始之前就编写了标准，在外部 agent 留下的目录树上从 fixture 恢复了不可变路径，确认由检查拥有的文件集未被改动，并亲自运行了检查。它不证明工作是如何完成的：外部 agent 的提示、工具调用和推理都留在它自己的产品里，因此 cell 会话只保存 stamp、标准、委托记录、运行和证书，而没有任何助手轮次。导出的 trajectory 因此不含任何步骤。它是一次测量，而不是训练数据，stamp 上的 `implementer` 字段就是经策展的导出所要过滤的依据。[外部实现者说明](../../.agents/notes/proposed/architecture/2026-09-06-external-implementer.md)拥有这些规则。
+

+第三十份记录是在修复后的叠加层下作为一次 fleet 运行的丢弃臂，于 17:43 UTC 启动，比它的基线晚八十分钟：同样的 16 个单元，种子 2，同一阶梯，每一级都是运行器进程内的一个新子代理，在该级的模型上运行，任务被重述、指令被带上，同样的上限，两个单元并行共 5,816 s 墙上时间。它认证了 16 之 14：2 个在第一级由最小模型取得（ranked-choice，两次重复），11 个在第二级由最大模型取得，1 个在第三级（diff3-merge）；它的两次错过（conf-canon 与 sheet-eval，各一次重复）从未到达强模型那一级，因为最小模型的单次尝试在重读自己的对话记录上已花掉单元 1,500,000 计费 token 中的 1,493,040 与 1,472,984，运行器在突破的上限上拒绝了第二级。对第二十九份的基线臂离线折叠（[folds/2026-09-08-e5-drop-against-kept-transcript-t5.json](folds/2026-09-08-e5-drop-against-kept-transcript-t5.json)），读数为 0.1875，[0.0625, 0.3125]，按折叠的阈值为 `promote`：三个单元翻转，全部朝向新子代理，全部在保留对话记录所失败的三个任务上（build-schedule、conf-canon、sheet-eval），没有反向的，两臂的第一级都是 16 之 2。新子代理并不更便宜：输出 token 575,350 对 471,583，计费 16,648,949 对 14,911,342，单元时间 11,377 s（中位数 678 s）对 6,964（中位数 441），因为每一级都从零读取任务与工作区；它买到的是一个从工作区与指令、而不是从廉价模型的对话记录起步的强模型级。这个折叠是离线的：两臂在共享订阅上相隔一小时运行，未曾一起冻结，所以它是对清单预测"丢弃廉价模型的对话记录优于保留它"的证据，而不是晋升；修复后叠加层上的冻结配对与 token 上限的按级份额已排入队列。被委托单元的用量按其 `environment/delegation` 事件求和，这些事件带有每个子代理报告的模型与用量；普查发现没有单元离开工作区，也没有任何读取被拒绝。
+
+第二十九份记录是路由假设的丢弃臂第一次运行时的样子，一个候选臂从未启动的冻结配对实验：基线臂——第一级最小模型、第二与第三级最大模型并保留对话记录（第二十七份的阶梯，再次走 route）——在种子 2 下以两个单元并行共 3,760 s 墙上时间跑完 16 个密封的第 5 层单元，认证了 16 之 11，2 个在第一级、9 个在第二级，五次错过各自被 1,500,000 计费 token 的上限截停（计费 1,471,243 到 1,515,456 个 token）；候选臂——同一阶梯，但每一级都是经 spawn 提供者的一个新的进程内子代理——在每个单元上都在会话存在之前就被拒绝，因为 [overlays/with-spawn.cordis.yml](../../examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/overlays/with-spawn.cordis.yml) 修补了一个基础组合从未命名的条目，而 include 插件会以一条无人打印的警告跳过这样的补丁，于是 `spawn` 名下没有注册任何提供者。实验折叠为 `inconclusive`，没有任何种子配对（[result.json](2026-09-08-bench-e5-handoff-drop-t5/result.json)），在一个组合本可在加载时拒绝的错误配置之前花掉了最大模型的一小时：叠加层现在插入该提供者（`5e06f652d`），fleet 与实验服务在任何单元运行之前拒绝不可用的实现者，`verify-cordis-config` 对触及不到任何条目的 include 补丁报错（`f0a684ef0`），并由此发现了另外两个带同一缺陷的组合。普查发现四个单元在八次工具调用中离开了工作区，其中两次提到运行目录，没有任何读取被拒绝。
+
+第二十八份记录是本计划收尾所要的保留集可靠性估计：中等模型在 harness 循环上的一次 fleet，覆盖八个保留环境（第 2 层三个、第 3 层三个、第 5 层两个），本计划中的任何审计、提示修正、叠加层或折叠都未触及它们，种子 3，两次重复，16 个单元，两个单元并行共 2,299 s 墙上时间，在密封组合（[cordis.yml](../../examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/cordis.yml)）上以其三次尝试为上限。它认证了 16 之 15，全部在第一次尝试；唯一的错过是重复 0 的 glob-brace，用尽三次尝试耗时 1,270 s，而它的同胞单元在第一次尝试 473 s 内通过，因此第 5 层的四个单元读作 4 之 3，第 2、3 层的十二个单元读作 12 之 12。各单元合计 4,543 s（中位数 210 s）、195 步、363,264 个输出 token 与 586,558 个缓存写入 token。观测台扣留全部八行，正如它在任何页面上都扣留保留集的行（[observatory.json](2026-09-08-bench-held-out-sonnet-all/observatory.json)：十六个会话的八个保留集行），所以这个数字读自 fleet 报告与会话日志，并作为 harness 循环在该模型上的未调优估计成立：在本计划中没有任何东西见过的任务上 16 之 15，旁边是经审计的第 5 层八个任务上的 16 之 13 到 15；两组的层级不同，所以只有第 5 层单元的 4 之 3 说的是经审计那一层的难度。普查发现一个单元在一次工具调用中离开了工作区，只到达上级目录，没有提到运行目录或同级单元，也没有任何读取被拒绝。

+第二十一份记录是第十三份记录在密封第 5 层上的形态：中等产品模型作为基线臂，最小模型作为候选臂，在 harness 循环上，覆盖同样经审计的八个环境，种子 2，两次重复，32 个单元，两个单元并行共 8,883 s 墙上时间，所用组合与第二十份相同（两个实验于 10:47 UTC 在 `32a2cac6a` 上一同重新启动，这也是两者行中所写的提交；第二十份的行原先写的是记录时的 head，已更正）。中等模型认证了 16 之 14（9 个在第一次尝试，5 个在第二次，sheet-eval 两次在三次尝试后错过）；最小模型认证了 16 之 1，即 ranked-choice 一次在第一次尝试，其余每个单元都用尽了三次尝试，delta −0.8125，区间 [−0.875, −0.75]，裁决为 reject：在第 5 层，最小模型不是这些任务的实现者，而在第 3 层它在证书上曾与中等模型持平。它也是记录在案最昂贵的一个臂：604 个模型步骤对 262，单元合计 11,227 s 对 6,337（中位数 725 s 对 297），736,856 个输出 token 对 481,591，1,077,050 个缓存写入 token 对 669,507，21,275,855 个缓存读取对 7,633,594，因为一个失败三次的单元会把自己不断增长的对话记录重读三遍。与第二十份记录合读，三个产品模型在每个单元上严格排序：最小模型认证的单元没有一个被中等模型错过，中等模型认证的单元没有一个被最大模型错过，因此对三个单模型臂的离线路由读数（[folds/2026-09-08-routing-t5-seed2.json](folds/2026-09-08-routing-t5-seed2.json)）是精确的而非估计的。逐单元挑选最便宜的认证模型的 oracle 就是最大模型本身（16 之 16，189,169 个输出 token，164 步，3,572 s），强模型优先的级联也是如此；覆盖三者的弱模型优先级联以 1,248,222 个输出 token 与 18,028 s 达到 16 之 16，是最大模型单独运行的 6.6 倍与 5.0 倍；中等模型再最大模型的级联为 525,564 个 token 与 7,006 s，即 2.8 倍与 2.0 倍。每一个从最大模型以下起步的级联都要先付清较小模型的全部失败再升级，所以在这个基准上，路由的问题不是先试哪个模型，而是能否在任何模型运行之前分辨出困难的单元，而印记中没有任何东西能分辨它。中等模型在这些单元上的三次运行也给出了基准的噪声底线（[folds/2026-09-08-sonnet-repeatability-t5-seed2.json](folds/2026-09-08-sonnet-repeatability-t5-seed2.json)）：两次密封运行（本记录与第二十份）在 16 个单元中的 15 个上一致，翻转一次；各自与未密封的第十八份在 16 之 14 与 16 之 13 上一致，其中 conf-canon 在两次密封运行中都认证两次，在未密封的那次中一次都没有。因此在十六个单元上 0.0625 的配对 delta 处于一个臂自身逐次运行的变动之内，而第二十份的 0.1875 是它的三倍。普查发现七个单元在十二次工具调用中提到了其父目录或运行目录；每一次这样的调用看到的都是密封后的空目录，也没有任何读取被拒绝。
